name: review-surface
context: Designing the surface an agent uses to report a code change to a human reviewer.

misfits.text: the reviewer cannot tell what actually changed
the verdict asserts what it cannot evidence
the review reads files outside the change's subsystem
the review costs more than the change warrants
the verdict cannot be replayed or audited
one failing check silently voids the whole review
style noise drowns the change's substance
the review process cannot improve its own criteria

links.why: a sliced context helps both visibility and isolation
clipping for cost can hide the context that shows what changed
evidence and replay are the same requirement viewed twice
excluding out-of-subsystem files removes most style noise
evidenced claims leave no room for unevidenced nits
replayable verdicts are the fossil record criteria evolve against
a review that survives failed checks can silently weaken its own bar
